idea-plugin.name: BrightScript Syntax
idea-plugin.description:
BrightScript and BrighterScript language support for WebStorm and other JetBrains IDEs.

Features:

  • Syntax highlighting for .brs and .bs files with a customizable color scheme
  • Code completion for keywords, types, and built-in functions
  • Quick Documentation (Ctrl+Q / hover) with signatures for built-in functions
  • Code folding for function, sub, if, for, while, class, namespace, and try blocks
  • Code formatting (Ctrl+Alt+L) with automatic block indentation
  • Smart Enter - auto-insert closing tags (end function, end if, end for, ...)
  • Comment continuation - pressing Enter inside a line comment starts the next line as a comment
  • Quick comment / uncomment with Ctrl+/
  • Flavour selector in the status bar for Roku projects with a flavours/ folder - switch brand assets and manifest in one click
  • Syntax error highlighting for unclosed strings, unmatched brackets, and unknown characters
  • Go to Declaration (Ctrl+Click on function calls)
  • Color preview in gutter for hex color literals with built-in color picker
  • Matching brace highlighting for (), [], and {}
  • Structure View (Ctrl+F12) - list of functions and subs in the file
  • Find Usages (Alt+F7) for functions and subs
  • Live templates: func, sub, if, ife, for, fore, wh, try, pr
  • BrighterScript language constructs: classes, namespaces, try/catch

About BrightScript:

BrightScript is a scripting language used for developing applications on Roku streaming devices. It is a BASIC-like language with object-oriented programming features.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.4.0

  • Structure View (Ctrl+F12 / Alt+7) - navigate functions and subs in the current file
  • Find Usages (Alt+F7) for functions and subs
  • Live templates: func, sub, if, ife, for, fore, wh, try, pr

1.3.5

  • Go to Declaration now also finds functions in BrighterScript (.bs) files
  • BrighterScript annotations (@inject) and template strings (`...`) are no longer marked as syntax errors
  • Fixed false "unclosed bracket" errors when brackets appear inside REM comments
  • Flavour selector now asks for confirmation before overwriting project files

1.3.4

  • Flavour selector - status bar widget for Roku projects with a flavours/ folder, applies the selected flavour (copies its images, assets, and manifest over the project root)
  • Comment continuation - pressing Enter inside a line comment (' or REM) automatically starts the next line with the same comment marker

1.3.3

  • Brace matcher - highlights matching parentheses (), brackets [], and braces {}

1.3.2

  • Quick Documentation (Ctrl+Q / hover) for built-in functions

1.3.1

  • Extended IDE compatibility up to 2026.1 (build 261.*)

1.3.0

  • Added BrighterScript (.bs) file support
  • Extended IDE compatibility up to 2025.1
  • Fixed color provider crash on IDEs without XML plugin
  • Added 'void' type keyword highlighting
  • Fixed lexer token classification for overlapping keyword/type/builtin sets

1.2.9

  • Color preview in gutter - hex color literals (&hRRGGBB, &hRRGGBBAA) now show a colored square in the editor gutter with built-in color picker
